messages:
Ethan Brooks: hi team — quick sanity check. my calendar shows two orientation invites for next Tues (one Zoom, one Meet). which is the official one?
Nina Patel: official = Zoom from onboarding@redwood.com. the Meet copy is a calendar sync bug that affected some domains last week. decline the Meet invite.
Ravi Shah: i accepted the Meet accidentally. will declining remove it from my calendar or do i need to delete it?
Becca Ortiz: decline should remove it. if it persists, delete the event and accept the onboarding calendar invite directly (link in event description).
Ethan Brooks: thanks. also curious if the invite subject should show PT instead of PST — a few candidates got confused during hiring.
Nina Patel: good point. we've updated titles to include PT explicitly. new subject format: "Orientation — 09:00 PT / 17:00 BST / 21:30 IST".
Onboarding Bot: Recording: yes. Uploaded within ~30-60 minutes after end. Captioning enabled (English). Retention default: 60 days. For translated captions or extended retention, email onboarding@redwood.com.
Ravi Shah: will slides be attached to the recording or in Drive?
Becca Ortiz: slides go to Drive folder linked in the calendar: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Onboard_v2. Recording link is separate.
Ethan Brooks: perfect. last ask: any pre-session checklist in the calendar? (VPN, Slack, laptop image)
Nina Patel: added a short checklist to the event description and a bullet for APAC replay times.
Ethan Brooks: great, all sorted. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
